title: AI robotics may need 10 million hours of interaction data to reach production-level capabilities: Goldman Sachs
description: New Delhi [India], October 30 (ANI): General-purpose artificial intelligence (AI) robotics could require an estimated 10 million hours of high-quality physical interaction data to reach production-level capabilities, highlighting the challenges in achieving commercial viability, even as technological progress in the sector is projected to be two to four times faster than the historical pace of autonomous driving technology, according to a report by Goldman Sachs.

title: Wall Street’s AI love affair turns sour as Intel crashes 29%, Nasdaq takes a beating
description: Semiconductor shares led Friday's technology rout, with Nvidia and AMD joining Intel in steep declines. The selloff came despite better-than-expected earnings from most S&P 500 companies that had reported.
